rationale: ZBRA gapped down ~14% on what appears to be a post-earnings reaction despite a beat, suggesting the market had priced in more or there are other concerns — this kind of gap-and-recover pattern is now mid-range (51.5% of today's range) with price below the 9-EMA ($326.11) and recent 1-minute candles showing fading momentum and declining closes. The spread is manageable but the stock is in a wide, volatile range with ATR of $3.08 on 5-minute bars, making stop placement costly relative to available budget. With three working orders already consuming 9% of buying power and no clear directional edge at this mid-range location, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure.
